svg.aria-label: How symcc works: you are the team lead. You tell the lead agent what you want; it breaks the work into tasks on the board; worker agents build them in parallel, each in its own worktree; every change is checked and tested; you approve and it is merged into main. Scouts wake up on a timer, find the next job and report it to the lead, which adds a task for a free worker.
svg.title: How symcc works

text.tspan: The lead breaks it into tasks
Workers pick up tasks in parallel
Scouts look ahead on their own
